a1
At ninety-nine, Abram heard the Lord: I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.
b1
Abram fell on his face. God said: I make my covenant with you.
b2
You will be the father of many nations. Your name will be Abraham.
c1
I will be your God and your descendants' God forever, and Canaan will be their land.
c2
The sign of the covenant: every male in Abraham's household would be circumcised.
d1
God also renamed Sarai: she will be Sarah, mother of nations.
d2
Abraham fell down laughing: can a man of a hundred and a woman of ninety have a child?
d3
God said: Sarah will bear you a son. Name him Isaac, and my covenant will be with him.
e1
Ishmael would be blessed too, and become a great nation.
e2
Isaac would be born by this time next year.
e3
That day, Abraham did all that God had said.
h1
God changed Abram's name before the promise came true.
h2
He called him father of many nations while he still waited for a child.
h3
God sees us by his promise, not by our past.
h4
Today, believe what God says about you, over what you say about yourself.
i
What has God said about you that you doubt?
